title: OmaHotkeys
deletedUndo: Shortcut deleted. Use Undo deletion to restore it.
undoDisabled: Shortcut restored disabled because its keys are in use: %1
name: Name
recordHelp: Hold Shift, Ctrl, Super or Alt, then press a key. Escape cancels. You can also type the shortcut manually.
recordUnsupported: This key cannot be recorded. Press another key, or cancel and enter its XKB name manually.
text: Text to type (for example an email address)
textHelp: Release all shortcut keys to type this text into the focused input. Text is inserted literally without changing your clipboard. Maximum 2048 characters. Newlines and tabs act like Enter and Tab, so use them carefully. Do not store passwords.
commandHelp: Commands run locally when you press the shortcut. Only use commands you trust. Prefer a modifier; plain keys can interfere with typing.
disabledConflict: Saved disabled; enabling will require resolving: %1
invalidResponse: The shortcut helper returned an invalid response.
pausedNotice: All OmaHotkeys shortcuts are paused. Individual enabled states are preserved.
importPathHelp: Browse for a local JSON file anywhere you can access, or enter its full path. Imported shortcuts will be disabled for review.
exportPathHelp: Browse for an export destination, or enter its full path. Review the plain-text warning before writing the file.
exportWarning: This export includes every shortcut, including stored text and commands, in plain text—even when the value column is hidden. It may contain sensitive information. Save it only to a trusted location. An existing selected file will be replaced.

importSummary.one: Add %1 shortcut disabled for review; skip %2 duplicates. Existing shortcuts will not be replaced. Only enable imported commands you trust.
importSummary.other: Add %1 shortcuts disabled for review; skip %2 duplicates. Existing shortcuts will not be replaced. Only enable imported commands you trust.

importDone: Shortcuts imported disabled. The previous configuration was backed up in omarchy/omashortcuts/backups under your configuration directory.
tableHint: Click a column header to sort. Select a row to edit or delete. Double-click or press Enter to edit. Document = text; terminal = command.
scope: OmaHotkeys manages its own shortcuts only. Native and other custom bindings are read-only. Submaps and physical keys are checked conservatively against the configured layouts.
